message.content: {"output_action": "CREATE", "skill_draft": {"name": "fallback_to_report_on_low_confidence_classifier", "description": "When the chest X-ray classifier returns empty or low-confidence findings despite clinical suspicion of pathology, invoke the report generator to extract descriptive morphological evidence for differential diagnosis.", "applicable_conditions": "Applicable in differential diagnosis tasks where initial automated image classification yields negative or inconclusive results (empty strong_findings) but the patient's clinical context suggests underlying pathology.", "branch": "task_level", "tool_name": null, "task_category": ["differential_diagnosis"], "required_tools": ["chest_xray_classifier", "chest_xray_report_generator"], "risk_level": "medium", "core_action": "If `chest_xray_classifier` returns empty `strong_findings` or low confidence scores: (1) Do NOT conclude 'no pathology' based solely on this output; (2) Immediately invoke `chest_xray_report_generator` to retrieve the full textual radiology report; (3) Extract descriptive morphological findings from the text to support or refine the differential diagnosis."}, "patch_target_id": null, "patch_section": null, "patch_content": null}
